stablecoin_identity_rule.rule: USD, USDT and USDC are independently representable canonical assets. No USDT->USD or USDC->USD mapping logic may exist. Stablecoin-denominated notional is not silently equal to USD notional. No fiat classification may be derived from symbol text.

opaque_token_definition.law: non-blank, no leading/trailing whitespace, otherwise uninterpreted and preserved verbatim
opaque_token_definition.rationale: The smallest faithful representation that preserves the value without claiming a closed vocabulary (directive §4/§37). A closed enum for any of these fields would be an operator decision, recorded as such.
